environment: This is the RepoPulse repository (github.com/tlamDson/RepoPulse), a personal open-source data engineering project owned by the user. Its git remote origin and the GitHub repo tlamDson/RepoPulse are trusted.
Sessions run unattended through scripts/orchestrate.py: each PR runs in its own git worktree under .claude/worktrees/pr-<id> inside this repository, branched from origin/develop.
Downloading public hourly files from https://data.gharchive.org/ (GH Archive) and installing pinned Python packages from PyPI are normal parts of this project.
allow: Creating, editing and deleting files inside this repository's .claude/worktrees/ directory and inside Claude's own scratchpad or temp directory is routine work and always allowed.

Committing and pushing branches named feature/*, fix/*, test/*, docs/*, chore/* or release/* to origin, and opening pull requests into develop or main on tlamDson/RepoPulse, is the normal workflow and always allowed.

Squash-merging a pull request into develop with `gh pr merge <n> --squash --delete-branch` is allowed when all three CI checks (Lint, Unit Tests, dbt build (DuckDB)) are green and the code-reviewer agent concluded PASS.
Merging the develop -> main release pull request with `gh pr merge <n> --merge` is allowed when its CI checks are green; the repository owner authorised automatic releases.
Temporarily editing a committed source file to run a mutation test and then restoring it with `git checkout -- <file>` is a routine review step and always allowed.

Running pytest, ruff, dbt (DuckDB target ci), python scripts/*.py and python benchmarks/*.py inside this repository or its worktrees, and writing test or review evidence files there, is routine and always allowed.
Triggering this repository's own workflows with `gh workflow run` and reading run results with `gh run view` / `gh run list` is routine and always allowed.
Posting review comments on this repository's pull requests with `gh pr comment` is routine and always allowed.
hard_deny: Never run `gh secret` commands and never read, print or copy the contents of .env files or token values.
Never push directly to the develop or main branches, never force-push, and never use `gh pr merge --admin` or change branch protection.
Never edit .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/auto-mode.json or files under .claude/hooks/ during an unattended session.
